runs.question: How long after OMB M-25-22 is issued does it start to apply to new AI contracts?

answer.text:
M-25-22 applies 180 days after it is issued. It shall apply to any contract awarded pursuant to a solicitation issued on or after the date that is 180 days after issuance of this memorandum, as well as to any option to renew or extend the period of performance exercised on an existing contract after the date that is 180 days after the issuance of this memorandum.

The memorandum is dated April 2025 in its title, but the passages don't give the exact issue day, so I can't name a calendar date for the start. The rule also has a carve-out: this memorandum does not apply to AI acquired for use as a component of a National Security System.

support.reason: The passage states the same applicability to solicitations and options issued or exercised after the 180-day date.
The passage states the memorandum does not apply to AI acquired for use as a component of a National Security System.
